description: Recommends a size in one shirt for this man, from the shirts he already owns that fit. Returns the size, why (in terms of his own shirts), how it will fit, and a confidence. The size already accounts for his shirts, the fabric (including dryer shrinkage) and the cut.

dress_shirt_size.description: His dress shirt size off the label, if he knows it, e.g. "17 34/35" (neck, sleeve). Helps with long sleeves.

fit_preference.description: How he likes shirts to fit, if he said. Default standard.

my_shirts.description: Shirts he owns, ideally 3-5 that fit him well. Brand, item and size only.

belly.description: How it fits at the belly, if he said. Many guys find shirts right at the chest and tight at the belly.

chest.description: How it fits through the chest and shoulders, if he said.

fit.description: How it fits him overall. Default "fits". The chest, belly and length fields say where it's off.

item.description: The shirt, e.g. "AIRism Cotton T-Shirt" or "golf polo"

length.description: How long it is on him, if he said ("rides up" is too short).

size.description: Size on the tag, e.g. "L" or "XL Tall"

shirt.description: The shirt he is thinking of buying.

suit_size.description: His suit jacket size off the label, if he knows it, e.g. "44L" or "42 Regular". Helps with Tall sizes.

name: size_me
title: Which size should I buy?
